visual_anatomy.title: A personal commercial-result headline gives the stated customer count its own large lavender rough-display tag, followed by a compact explanation of the claimed distribution approach.
visual_anatomy.layout: Two equal vertical columns separate a carousel asset map from a supporting text-post map. The left column groups numbered slide thumbnails by narrative role; the right column stacks labelled text-post blocks in sequence.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Claimed result and premise → left carousel sequence from outcome through proof and logistics → right text-post sequence from hook through call to action → understand the two as a connected distribution system.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large thin headline, rough display number phrase, bold section bands, compact narrative labels, and tiny thumbnail facsimiles that act as evidence or retrieval cues rather than fully readable content.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender structures the carousel column, pink structures the text-post column, and pale related washes sit behind the repeated module groups.
visual_anatomy.surface: White ground, fine black outer frames, rounded lavender/pink headers, soft shadows, connecting bracket lines, and miniature slide cards in sequence.
visual_anatomy.modules: One left-side four-group carousel blueprint and one right-side six-block promotional text sequence.
visual_anatomy.density: High: a claimed result, a multi-slide asset architecture, and a separate promotion architecture coexist because each column has one repeated reading grammar.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: See how a durable asset and its repeated promotion can work together, rather than mistaking a single post for the complete system.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Paired content architecture and distribution architecture.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Show the asset sequence and the distribution sequence in parallel, so a reader can distinguish what must be made once from what must be repeated or adapted.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when the asset thumbnails or source documents are owned, licensed, or sufficiently legible to substantiate the architecture; claimed outcomes require independent evidence.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the claimed customer count, carousel topics, post sequence, source thumbnails, pink-and-lavender two-column system, title treatment, or direct-response language.

claim_boundary.note: The stated customer count, follower and impression claims, and customer-acquisition mechanism appear in the source asset without independently verifiable provenance.
